description: Use this when the person asks to see their resumes, or a resume's id is needed. Returns master resumes and tailored versions, newest first, each with a label (company, job, date) and its ATS score. A limit above 50 is treated as 50. No contact details.

role.description: Only resumes whose role contains this, e.g. Director.

search.description: Company, job or name contains this.

since.description: ISO date-time; only resumes made after it.

name: list_resumes
title: List resumes
